title: Typed article and source-aware inline editing

verificationRecords.command: npm run test:fraction-notebook; npm run typecheck:fraction-notebook; npm run visual:fraction-notebook; npm run check:architecture; npm run test:project-vision

verificationRecords.notes: Nine unit/preservation checks, eight Chromium checks and 75 orientation checks pass. Scoped types and architecture pass.
